versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Reads a feature screenplay or TV pilot and produces industry-standard coverage with logline, one-page synopsis, character breakdown, fixed-anchor craft grid (Excellent / Good / Fair / Poor), comments tied to specific pages and beats, producibility notes, comps, and a separate script and writer verdict (Pass / Consider / Recommend).
